summary.text: Mark Vallone is the incumbent Democratic candidate for the New Hampshire House of Representatives, Rockingham 5, in the November 3, 2026 general election. Ballotpedia lists his tenure in the current seat as beginning in 2022, after an earlier term from 2018 to 2020 representing Rockingham 9.

paragraphs.text: Vallone was born in Epping, New Hampshire.
He earned a B.A. from Bowdoin College and an M.A. and a certificate of advanced graduate study from the University of New Hampshire.
His career experience includes working as a teacher, principal, and coach.
